Properties.Definition: Indication that this object is designed to be accessible by the handicapped. Set to (TRUE) if this object is rated as handicap accessible according to the local building codes, otherwise (FALSE). It is giving according to the requirements of the national building code.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Floor Covering
Properties.Definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp. The material information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=FLOORING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to [[IfcCovering]] elements takes precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Floor Covering Thickness
Properties.Definition: [[Thickness]] of the material layer(s) for the space flooring. The thickness information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=FLOORING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned [[IfcCovering]] and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Wall Covering
Properties.Definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space cladding. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp. The material information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=CLADDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to [[IfcCovering]] elements takes precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Wall Covering Thickness
Properties.Definition: [[Thickness]] of the material layer(s) for the space cladding. The thickness information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=CLADDING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned [[IfcCovering]] and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Ceiling Covering
Properties.Definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space ceiling. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp. The material information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=[[CEILING]]) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to [[IfcCovering]] elements takes precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Ceiling Covering Thickness
Properties.Definition: [[Thickness]] of the material layer(s) for the space ceiling. The thickness information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=[[CEILING]]) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned [[IfcCovering]] and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Skirting Board
Properties.Definition: Label to indicate the material or construction of the skirting board around the space flooring. The label is used for room book information. The material information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=SKIRTINGBOARD) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to [[IfcCovering]] elements takes precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Skirting Board Height
Properties.Definition: [[Height]] of the skirting board. The height information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=SKIRTINGBOARD) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the height assigned to [[IfcCovering]] elements takes precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Molding
Properties.Definition: Label to indicate the material or construction of the molding around the space ceiling. The label is used for room book information. The material information is provided in absence of an [[IfcCovering]] (type=MOLDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to [[IfcCovering]] elements takes precedence.

Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Concealed Flooring
Properties.Definition: Indication whether this space is designed to have a concealed flooring space (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed flooring space is normally meant to be the space beneath a raised floor.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Concealed Flooring Offset
Properties.Definition: Distance between the floor slab and the floor covering, often used for cables and other installations. Often referred to as raised flooring.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcNonNegativeLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Concealed Ceiling
Properties.Definition: Indication whether this space is designed to have a concealed flooring space (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed ceiling space is normally meant to be the space between a slab and a ceiling.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Concealed Ceiling Offset
Properties.Definition: Distance between the upper floor slab and the suspended ceiling, often used for distribution systems. Often referred to as plenum.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcNonNegativeLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Fire Risk Factor
Properties.Definition: Fire Risk factor assigned to the space according to local building regulations. It defines the fire risk of the space at several levels of fire hazard.

Properties.Name: Flammable Storage
Properties.Definition: Indication whether the space is intended to serve as a storage of flammable material (which is regarded as such by the presiding building code. (TRUE) indicates yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Air Pressurization

Properties.Name: Temperature Max
Properties.Definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Temperature Min
Properties.Definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Temperature Summer Max
Properties.Definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Temperature Summer Min
Properties.Definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

Properties.Definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure as value.

Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveRatioMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Humidity Max
Properties.Definition: Maximal permitted humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveRatioMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Humidity Min
Properties.Definition: Minimal permitted humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveRatioMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Humidity Summer
Properties.Definition: Humidity of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveRatioMeasure as value.

Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveRatioMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Total Radiant Load
Properties.Definition: Total electromagnetic energy added or removed by emission or absorption. If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

Properties.Definition: Sum of all ceiling areas of the space. It includes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.). The ceiling area is the real (and not the projected) area (e.g. in case of sloped ceilings).

Properties.Name: Net Ceiling Area
Properties.Definition: Sum of all ceiling areas of the space. It excludes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.). The ceiling area is the real (and not the projected) area (e.g. in case of sloped ceilings).

Properties.Name: Contributed Luminous Flux
Properties.Definition: Luminous flux is a photometric measure of radiant flux, i.e. the volume of light emitted from a light source. Luminous flux is measured either for the interior as a whole or for a part of the interior (partial luminous flux for a solid angle). All other photometric parameters are derivatives of luminous flux. Luminous flux is measured in lumens (lm). The luminous flux is given as a nominal value for each lamp.

Properties.Name: Lamp Ballast Type
Properties.Definition: The type of ballast used to stabilise gas discharge by limiting the current during operation and to deliver the necessary striking voltage for starting. Ballasts are needed to operate Discharge Lamps such as Fluorescent, Compact Fluorescent, High-pressure Mercury, Metal Halide and High-pressure Sodium Lamps.; Magnetic ballasts are chokes which limit the current passing through a lamp connected in series on the principle of self-induction. The resultant current and power are decisive for the efficient operation of the lamp. A specially designed ballast is required for every type of lamp to comply with lamp rating in terms of Luminous Flux, Color Appearance and service life. The two types of magnetic ballasts for fluorescent lamps are KVG Conventional (EC-A series) and VVG Low-loss ballasts (EC-B series). Low-loss ballasts have a higher efficiency, which means reduced ballast losses and a lower thermal load. Electronic ballasts are used to run fluorescent lamps at high frequencies (approx. 35 - 40 kHz).

Often the values are only approximate colour temperatures as the black-body radiator cannot emit radiation of every chromaticity value. The colour temperatures of the commonest artificial light sources range from less than 3000K (warm white) to 4000K (intermediate) and over 5000K (daylight).

Properties.Definition: Lining material or 'NOT LINED' or '[[UNKNOWN]]' (boreholeML).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Undisturbed Volume
Properties.Definition: Undisturbed [[Volume]]

Properties.Name: Loose Volume
Properties.Definition: [[Volume]] of the earthworks when in a loose piled state.

Properties.Name: Compacted Volume
Properties.Definition: [[Volume]] of the earthworks when finished and compacted in place.

Properties.Name: Approach Speed
Properties.Definition: The design speed of trains approaching the signal if different from the line speed.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLinearVelocityMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Hand Signalling Prohibited
Properties.Definition: Indicates if hand signalling is prohibited in case of any failure.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Limited Clearances
Properties.Definition: tunnels, bridges, viaducts.

Properties.Name: Number of Lamps Not Used
Properties.Definition: Number of lamps which are not needed and blanked out (sealed).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcCountMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Requires OLE Mesh
Properties.Definition: Indicates whether an OLE mesh is required to protect the signal or maintainer.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Requires Safety Handrail
Properties.Definition: Indicates whether a safety handrail is required.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Post Telephone ID
Properties.Definition: The identifier of the signal post telephone attached to the signal.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcIdentifier as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Post Telephone Type
Properties.Definition: Indicates the type of the signal post telephone, e.g. locked, direct line, dial phone.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Special Position Arrangement
Properties.Definition: Type of special position at which the signal is placed.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Hindering Obstacles Description
Properties.Definition: [[Description]] of obstacles that hinder the visibility for the staff in the station.

Properties.Name: Signal Walkway Length
Properties.Definition: Indicates the length of the walkway from signal to signal post telephone.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Requires Banner Signal
Properties.Definition: Indicates whether a banner repeater signal is required.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Distance to Stop Mark
Properties.Definition: Distance from the signal to the nearest stop mark at a platform.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Indicator Type
Properties.Definition: Type of the indicators on a signal, e.g. route indicator, speed restriction indicator etc.

Properties.Name: Lens Diffuser Type
Properties.Definition: Type of the lens diffuser the signal is equipped with.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Has Conductor Rail Guard Board
Properties.Definition: Indicates if a guard board is provided.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Maximum Display Distance
Properties.Definition: The maximum distance that can be displayed. The value relates only to the signal type, not to the circumstances at a special position.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Required Display Distance
Properties.Definition: The required distance that has to be displayed. The value relates only to the signal type, not to the circumstances at a special position.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Is High Type
Properties.Definition: Indicates if the signal is high (TRUE) or dwarf (ground mounted) (FALSE).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Hood Length
Properties.Definition: Nominal length of the signal hood, which is the signal lamp cover against glaring sun.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Hot Strip Orientation
Properties.Definition: Position of the hot strip, which indicates the direction of the focus of the light beam and is given in terms like 'left upper quadrant (LUQ)' or '5 o'clock'.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Lens Diffuser Orientation
Properties.Definition: [[Orientation]] the lens diffuser has to have, which indicates the direction of the lens diffuser and is given in terms like 'left upper quadrant (LUQ)' or '5 o'clock'.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Number of Lamps
Properties.Definition: Number of lamps the signal is composed of.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcCountMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Message
Properties.Definition: All possible message available at this signal, e.g. '3/4- display automatic blocking'.

Properties.Name: Railway Signal Type
Properties.Definition: The type of railway signal, e.g. home signal, starting signal, shunting signal, level crossing signal.

Properties.Name: Backboard Type
Properties.Definition: The type of the backboard of the signal frame.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Frame Type
Properties.Definition: Type of frame, e.g. main frame, route indicator, speed indicator, direction indicator, etc.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Frame Backboard Height
Properties.Definition: The nominal height of the signal frame backboard.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Signal Frame Backboard Diameter
Properties.Definition: The nominal diameter of the signal frame backboard.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Port Number
Properties.Definition: The port index for logically ordering the port within the containing element or element type.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcInteger as value.

Properties.Name: Colour Code
Properties.Definition: Name of a colour for identifying the connector, if applicable.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Work Start Time
Properties.Definition: The default time of day a task is scheduled to start. For presentation purposes, if the start time of a task matches the [[WorkStartTime]], then applications may choose to display the date only. Conversely when entering dates without specifying time, applications may automatically append the [[WorkStartTime]].
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcTime as value.

Properties.Name: Work Finish Time
Properties.Definition: The default time of day a task is scheduled to finish. For presentation purposes, if the finish time of a task matches the [[WorkFinishTime]], then applications may choose to display the date only. Conversely when entering dates without specifying time, applications may automatically append the [[WorkFinishTime]].
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcTime as value.

Properties.Name: Work Day Duration
Properties.Definition: The elapsed time within a worktime-based day. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display [[IfcTask]] durations in work days where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 24 hours (an elapsed day); if omitted then 8 hours is assumed.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcDuration as value.

Properties.Name: Work Week Duration
Properties.Definition: The elapsed time within a worktime-based week. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display [[IfcTask]] durations in work weeks where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 168 hours (an elapsed week); if omitted then 40 hours is assumed.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcDuration as value.

Properties.Name: Work Month Duration
Properties.Definition: The elapsed time within a worktime-based month. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display [[IfcTask]] durations in work months where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 744 hours (an elapsed month of 31 days); if omitted then 160 hours is assumed.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcDuration as value.

Properties.Name: Nominal Body Length
Properties.Definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the x-axis of the local coordinate system of the object.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Nominal Body Width
Properties.Definition: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the y-axis of the local coordinate system of the object.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Nominal Body Depth
Properties.Definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the z-axis of the local coordinate system of the object.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Inlet Connection Size
Properties.Definition: [[Size]] of the inlet connection.; Note that all inlet connections are assumed to be the same size.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Outlet Connection Size
Properties.Definition: [[Size]] of the outlet connection from the object.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Cover Length
Properties.Definition: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the cover of the object.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Cover Width
Properties.Definition: The length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the cover of the object.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Ventilating Pipe Size
Properties.Definition: [[Size]] of the ventilating pipe(s).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Asset Accounting Type
Properties.Definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

Properties.Name: Asset Tax Type
Properties.Definition: Identifies the predefined types of taxation group from which the type required may be set.

Properties.Name: Asset Insurance Type
Properties.Definition: Identifies the predefined types of insurance rating from which the type required may be set.

Properties.Name: Asset Status
Properties.Definition: Current status or stage in life cycle.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Asset Use
Properties.Definition: General use category of the asset.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Style
Properties.Definition: [[Description]] of the furniture style.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Main Colour
Properties.Definition: The main colour of the furniture of this type.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Is Built In
Properties.Definition: Indicates whether the furniture type is intended to be 'built in' i.e. physically attached to a building or facility (= TRUE) or not i.e. Loose and movable (= FALSE).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Is Used
Properties.Definition: Indicates whether the element is being used in a workstation (= TRUE) or not.(= FALSE).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Group Code
Properties.Definition: E.g. panels, worksurfaces, storage, etc.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcIdentifier as value.

Properties.Name: Finishing
Properties.Definition: The finishing applied to system furniture elements of this type e.g. walnut, fabric.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Combined Kerb Gutter
Properties.Definition: Indicating the use of a combined kerb and gutter.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Upstand
Properties.Definition: The height difference between the two separated surfaces.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcNonNegativeLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Mountable
Properties.Definition: Specifies whether the kerb can be readily climbed by a vehicle or not.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcBoolean as value.

Properties.Name: Stone Finishes
Properties.Definition: Eg. 'Polished', 'Bush Hammered', 'Split', 'Sawn', 'Flamed'.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Curve Shape
Properties.Definition: Shape according to CurveShapeEnum.

Properties.Name: Radius
Properties.Definition: The radius of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Crossfall
Properties.Definition: Specifies the nominal crossfall as a ratio measure (slope) at the location of the event.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcRatioMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Design Speed
Properties.Definition: Speed selected in designing a new road or in modernizing, strengthening or rehabilitating an existing road section, to determine the various geometric design features of the carriageway that allow a car to travel safely at that speed, under normal road surface and weather conditions. NOTE Definition according to PIARC.; NOTE The design speed is not constant, but may vary depending on the conditions of relief (plain, hill, mountain).
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLinearVelocityMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Design Traffic Volume
Properties.Definition: The traffic volume used for planning and design purposes specified as the number of vehicles per day . Typically given as AADT - Average Annual Daily Traffic.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcCountMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Design Vehicle Class
Properties.Definition: A vehicle designator with content according to local standards.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.

Properties.Name: Lane Width
Properties.Definition: [[Standard]] nominal width of one trough lane.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcPositiveLengthMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Number of Through Lanes
Properties.Definition: The total number of through lanes on the segment. This excludes auxiliary lanes, parking and turning lanes, acceleration/deceleration lanes, toll collection lanes, shoulders etc.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcCountMeasure as value.

Properties.Name: Road Design Class
Properties.Definition: A road design class designator with content according to local standards.
Properties.Description: Technical note: in IFC this property takes IfcLabel as value.
